items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I had Lou McGarity, I had some really good players and we did -- had a jazz background for all the singers that came out and then did some jazz things ourselves.

ctx.x: A house band for what, Bud?

For Majestic Records. Playing for people like the DeMarco Sisters, there was a well-known, the Carpenter girl, I forget her first name -- Thelma Carpenter, played -- did a lot of dates, were doing a couple of dates a week and it was a great job, and then Walker, as I say, I used people like Yank Lawson, Bob Haggart, Peanuts Hucko, Gene Schroeder, who was playing with Condon -- oh, dear, I don't think Eddie made any of them, but anyway -- I had Lou McGarity, I had some really good players and we did -- had a jazz…
was the end of that job, but while it was going on I had a nice thing, because I was playing concerts at schools, playing the off night with an all-star band at Condon's and had that job.
